### Install

- **Linux** — `$appimage`. `chmod +x` and execute, no install needed.
- **Windows** — `$nsis`.
- **Android** — `yumezu.apk`, arm64 only.
- **macOS** — `$dmg`, Apple Silicon only. Requires [dequarantining](https://github.com/Desdaemon/yumezu/blob/main/README.md#MacOS).
- Or in a browser: <https://explorer.yumemiru.dev>

If you have already installed yumezu on desktop, use **Check for updates** in the settings tab.
